scope: Selected source-backed response contracts and one finite engineering calculation; no measured product performance or complete patent model.

classification_baseline.note: The original role cleanup changed only entry 72. Reconstruction retains ids 1-74 using current family storage; the frozen compatibility test protects their contracts, descriptions and evidence.

cases.name: H2W VCS20-020-CR-001-XY voice-coil stage

sources.locator: Product specification table: resistance at 20 C, force constant and continuous force
sources.supports: A resistive coil produces force and dissipates electrical power. Published values are 3.5 ohm, 6.1 N/A and 8.9 N continuous force.

assumptions: Steady DC, fixed coil geometry, stationary stage and resistance at 20 C; motional back EMF and transient inductance are excluded.
not_covered: Closed-loop controller, motion dynamics, encoder, friction and coil temperature evolution.

cases.name: LG thermoelectric refrigerator disclosure, US11300331B2

sources.locator: Description of thermoelectric module 3 and claims 1 and 7
sources.supports: The disclosed refrigerator combines a thermoelectric element, cooling and heat sinks, and fan assemblies. The patent also describes controlling heated-air recirculation.
A thermoelectric system must reject pumped heat and electrical heating; conduction and convection are separately useful heat-transfer responses.

assumptions: The selected responses require separately declared operating interval, boundary temperatures, thermal paths, electrical loading and fluid conditions.
not_covered: Coupled hot/cold energy balances, heat-rate/time conversion, fan curve, recirculation geometry and gasket effectiveness. A list of matched effects does not verify these patent features.

cases.name: Transparent electrodynamic screen disclosure, US9433336B2

sources.locator: Abstract and description of three-phase excitation and particle forces
sources.supports: A patterned, insulated electrode array uses phased excitation to lift and transport dust through electrostatic and dielectrophoretic forces.

sources.locator: History and Flight Development of the Electrodynamic Dust Shield, abstract and operating description
sources.supports: NASA describes traveling-field dust transport using the two force responses. This is supporting mechanism evidence, not identification of the patent with a NASA product.

assumptions: Specified particle charge/polarizability, electrode geometry, phased drive, adhesion and surface conditions.
not_covered: Drive-to-field synthesis, simultaneous force balance, particle trajectories and measured dust-clearing efficiency. The two force responses are not a serial recipe.

voice_coil_calculation.scope: Calculated points under the stated linear DC model using published coefficients; these are not manufacturer measurements at the selected points.
